column3: “Wailing” is rendered “howl.”
Close to the Greek.
“Corroded” is rendered “rusted,” “testimony” “witness,” and “eat” “consume”; NASB supplies “It is … that” and “your treasure.”
“Wage” is rendered “pay,” and “workmen” “laborers”; NASB supplies “against you,” and renders “Lord of Hosts” as “Lord of Sabaoth.”
NASB follows the critical text (“in a day of slaughter,” without “as”).
NASB supplies “man.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “rain”; “fruit of the earth” is rendered “produce of the soil.”
“Has drawn near” is rendered “is at hand.”
NASB follows the critical text; “grumble” is rendered “complain,” and “has been stood before the doors” “is standing right at the door.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “my”; “of suffering evils” is rendered “of suffering.”
NASB follows the critical text (“endured”); it supplies “dealings.”
NASB follows the critical text (“under judgment”).
“Suffering hardships” is rendered “suffering.”
“Call near” is rendered “call for.”
“The prayer of faith” is rendered “the prayer offered in faith,” and “save” “restore.”
NASB follows the critical text (“Therefore,” “your sins”); NASB renders “being made effective” as “effective.”
“Of like nature” is rendered “with a nature like ours,” and “with prayer he prayed” “prayed earnestly.”
“Gave rain” is rendered “poured rain,” and “heaven” “sky.”
NASB follows the critical text (“My brethren”).
Close to the Greek.
